title: Pasting ordinary square-comparison equations
statement: If OrdinarySquareComparison holds for β:I⋙P→A⋙B and β′:i⋙p→a⋙b, and also for θ:A⋙B→R⋙K and θ′:a⋙b→r⋙k, using the same intermediate evaluation comparisons, it holds for β≫θ and β′≫θ′.

source.place: Functoriality and associativity in Construction 4.1; the generic component-pasting calculation is agent-formulated.

proof.text: At each source object map the composite β≫θ with Functor.map_comp. Substitute the comparison equation for θ, then the equation for β with the remaining θ′ component on the right. Associativity gives precisely the field equation for the composite.
